claim_limits: exact-checked finite-domain active hard/soft fixtures only
single-process wall observations are not matched timing evidence
no solver, sampler, model, or hardware speedup claim is allowed

field_principles.active_constraint_sparse_repair_ready: readiness gate for exact-checked active-constraint repair.
field_principles.confidence_intervals: uncertainty over success and iteration summaries, not headline proof.
field_principles.exact_fallback_rate: fraction of policy attempts with exact accept/reject validation.
field_principles.field_principles: keeps headline and gate fields annotated by evidence boundaries.
field_principles.fixture_families: names the larger exact-checkable fixture families behind the aggregate.
field_principles.honest_verdict: terminal status; start with complete: or blocked: and avoid speedup claims.
field_principles.inference_substrate: declares exact-checked sparse repair scale-up, no live inference.
field_principles.matched_timing_available: matched timing gate for any future speedup language.
field_principles.mean_iterations_exact_only: iteration evidence for the exact-only baseline.
field_principles.mean_iterations_sparse_repair: iteration evidence for sparse repair; not a speedup claim.
field_principles.n_instances: bounds the scale-up evidence size without implying benchmark breadth.
field_principles.n_seeds: records deterministic multi-seed evidence rather than a single lucky row.
field_principles.random_block_success_rate: same-size random block control under exact checking.
field_principles.sparse_repair_success_rate: descriptor-guided repair acceptance under exact checking.
field_principles.speedup_claim_allowed: must remain false without matched timing evidence.
field_principles.tests_added_or_reused: names the tests supporting this artifact.

tests_run.command: coverage run --source=carnot -m pytest tests/python/test_experiment_5531_sparse_repair_scaleup_ci.py -q -o addopts= && coverage report --include=*/experiment_5531_sparse_repair_scaleup_ci.py --fail-under=100 --show-missing

wall_time_observations_s.methodology: single-process CPU wall observations, not matched timing evidence
